basic_info.description: US Bank loans on vacant land! Lot (2,618sf) with FULLY APPROVED PLANS to build a brand new, 3,257sf, single family residence. 4BRs, 3.1BAs plus large family room and additional media room. Decks front and rear. Wide front allowing for a wide, appealing great room-kitchen/dining/living area and wide master suite above. The entire back yard is level with large tree for nice outlooks and privacy. There are views from the front top floor of the city lights. It is close to Hwy 280 but as a new build, it can be sound insulated well. Shovel ready! Within walking distance to the Glen Park BART Station. New buildable lots are far and few between. Buyer is advised to check plans and confirm details. It is assumed you could revise plans relatively easy to include an ADU-check with SF Planning.
